change_summary: Route turns that follow a tool→assistant→user sequence to gpt-4.1-mini, as they are almost certainly pure JSON tool calls.
reason_for_change: Pure tool-call turns (≈1/3 per transcript, ~10 per task) are cheap to generate; routing only those (detected via tool→assistant→user pattern) to gpt-4.1-mini should cut ~30-40 % cost while keeping reasoning on gpt-4.1, so success rate stays unchanged.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — no cost improvement beyond noise: per-task cost 0.044843 >= threshold 0.037019 (best mean 0.039301 - 1σ·0.002281)
hypothesis: Routing all assistant turns whose sole goal is to issue a JSON tool call to gpt-4.1-mini will cut per-turn cost while keeping reasoning turns on gpt-4.1, sustaining accuracy.
